records.reason: A 1-action flourish that adds 1d6 spirit damage to the next Strike; a one-shot action resolved at the table, not a persistent sheet statistic.
Raises the dying value at which you die by 1 — the dyingThresholdBonus lane exists but the record carries nothing. (The 'doomed reduces max dying 1 less severely' clause has no lane and is left out.)
A 1-minute secret Nature activity that gets GM-narrated answers from a dead animal; exploration/downtime, no sheet statistic.

Steps your fist damage die from d4 to d6 and gives the fist the parry trait — the unarmedTraits lane covers exactly this and the record has no field. (The lethal-attack penalty removal and the granted action need nothing.)
A 1-action healing ability spending a spirit wisp/remnant; healing resolved at the table and can target an ally.
A 2-action area damage ability against creatures in a burst; affects targets only.
Attackers must succeed at a flat check or miss; the roll is made by the attacker at the table and is not a modifier to any of your statistics.
Grants the Spiritual Aid reaction — an action resolved at the table, no statistic changes.
A 2-action Strike that inflicts persistent damage and stupefied on the target; target-side only.
A spellshape that enlarges the next spell's area; area geometry is resolved at the table.
Lets you attempt haunt-detection checks while exploring without Searching; exploration-mode detection the app does not model.
Upgrades the Spiritual Strike action (off-guard on hit, +2d6 force); both the parent and this rider are resolved when the action is used at the table.
A secret exploration check to notice haunts, spirits and ethereal creatures; not one of the modelled senses and the app does not model exploration secret checks.
A 2-action Strike with ghost touch and bonus force damage; an action resolved at the table.
A 2-action claw Strike that dazzles or blinds the target; target-side condition only.

You choose four domains that REPLACE your deity's domain list, and the app's domain picker (choice kind 'domains' in Builder.tsx) enumerates strictly content.deities[deityId].domains, so Domain Initiate and friends still offer only the printed list. No field can override a deity's domain set.
Changes Spit Ambient Magic from single-target to an area; targeting geometry resolved at the table.
A 1-action flourish that Strides and Strikes from hiding; an action resolved at the table.
A 1-action Leap-and-Strike follow-up; an action resolved at the table.
Alternative multi-action Leap options and a Long Jump direction exception; jump distances are not modelled on the sheet.
Produces fruit that heals a creature OTHER than you; the benefit lands entirely on allies.
Extends the overwatch field around a corner; battlefield line-of-sight the GM adjudicates.
A free action that fakes a result for the enemy caster after you save; entirely GM-adjudicated deception of the opposing side.
Makes a surrounded enemy off-guard to you — a condition on the target, not a bonus to any of your statistics.
A reaction that downgrades a critical failure to a failure on a social check; a table-time degree-of-success change, no sheet statistic.
A reaction to attempt an Escape; grants an action, no statistic changes.
A 1-action flourish applying one Athletics roll to two foes; an action resolved at the table.
Removes the –2 circumstance penalty for attacking nonlethally with a lethal weapon; the app never applies that penalty, so encoding a bonus would be an over-grant.
You Command an Animal to make a boosted Strike that slows the target; the effect lands on the companion's Strike and the enemy, resolved at the table.
A ranged Strike that imposes a Speed penalty on the target; target-side only.

Grants you resistance to mental damage equal to half your level against the effect of a mental save you failed while using Stalwart Song — a real defensive resistance with nothing delivering it; conditional so it belongs in a mode, matching the existing triggered-resistance modes (e.g. adept-benefit-amulet).

mode.name: Stalwart Chant
mode.duration: against the effect of the mental save you failed
mode.note: Stalwart Chant: you can use Stalwart Song against any mental effect. If you fail that save, you gain resistance to mental damage equal to half your level against the resulting effect. Turn this on for that effect only.

records.reason: A 2-action Medicine check that reduces another creature's dying condition and damages adjacent creatures; affects allies and enemies, not your sheet.
A reaction to move and absorb damage aimed at an ally, with resistance applied to that one instance; a table-time reaction, not a persistent resistance.
A reactive melee Strike; grants an action resolved at the table.
Grants a transformation seal item and the Starlit Transformation activity; no statistic, proficiency, or spell is conferred by the dedication itself.
A 1-action ranged Strike that changes its own damage type and hampers the target; an action resolved at the table.
A 3-action area effect that damages enemies and creates difficult terrain; battlefield-side only.
A 1-action Strike that leaves the target off-guard and frightened; target-side conditions only.
Adds quickened to whoever receives temporary HP from In Lightning, Life; a condition applied to a target of your ability at the table.
A 2-action dynamo Strike with splash electricity damage; an action resolved at the table.
A 1-action Stride that forces enemies to save or lose reactions; enemy-side effect.
A 1-action pose granting a special Deception DC and off-guard until you act; a table-time disguise state, not a sheet statistic.
Upgrades the Shoulder Catastrophe reaction so you eat the whole critical instead of your ally; resolved when the reaction is used.
A 2-action Trip-then-Strike flourish with a MAP exception inside the activity itself; resolved at the table, not a persistent mapReduction.
Lets you Aid an ally's Will save without preparing; the bonus lands on the ally.

Calculates your DCs against Disarm/Steal attempts at mythic proficiency and adds half your level to your warshard weapon's Hardness and your level to its Hit Points. No field expresses a proficiency-rank override on a defensive DC or per-item Hardness/HP bonuses.
Upgrades a Balance success to a critical success and removes off-guard while Balancing; a degree-of-success change on one skill action, not a modifier.
Ignores stone/earth difficult terrain and upgrades Balance successes on such surfaces; terrain and degree-of-success handling the app does not model.
A flat check to avoid a disrupted spell; rolled at the table, no statistic changes.
Same flat check against disruption for the magus; rolled at the table.
A reaction that reduces another creature's doomed/dying and grants temporary fast healing to you and your mount; fast healing is not a modelled field and the reaction is resolved at the table.
A 2-action Thievery attempt that moves an item's magical properties for 24 hours; GM-adjudicated item manipulation.
A 2-action Grapple that drags the target into or deeper into water; forced movement of the target.
Lets you learn a spell you countered; a table-time addition the player makes through the normal spellbook/repertoire UI, with no fixed spell to grant.
Alters Vampiric Feast to attempt a counteract check on your own clumsy/enfeebled instead of granting temp HP; a per-cast counteract roll resolved at the table.
Treats 20+ feet of water as cover for Hiding; a battlefield cover ruling the GM adjudicates.
A spellshape that lets a fire spell work underwater and strips fire riders; resolved when the spell is cast.
Preserves your full action count while riding your eidolon and gives its move actions the tandem trait; mounted action economy is not modelled and companionMod has no lane for it.
Commands your steed to Strike with an extra damage die and knock the target prone; the effect lands on the companion's Strike and the enemy.
Grants only the Size Up action; no proficiency, statistic, or spell is conferred.
